battery.title: Keep tracking running
battery.subtitle: Some phones stop apps in the background to save battery. This can break your trip record.

xiaomi.s2: Choose Battery saver → No restrictions for Namma Lorry.
xiaomi.s3: Turn on Autostart for Namma Lorry.

vivo.s2: Allow background high power consumption for Namma Lorry.
vivo.s3: Lock Namma Lorry in the recent apps list.

oppo.s2: Allow Namma Lorry to run in the background.
oppo.s3: Turn off battery optimisation for Namma Lorry.

samsung.s2: Remove Namma Lorry from Sleeping apps.
samsung.s3: Set Namma Lorry to 'Unmonitored' under Battery → Background usage limits.

generic.s2: Choose Battery → Unrestricted for Namma Lorry.
generic.s3: Allow Namma Lorry to run in the background.
